node.statement: Target compressed-unit comparison. With a=P^R and A_R as in node 1.4, apply node 1.2 inside A_R with projection defect delta_R=K_a*t and ambient defect epsilon_R=K_R*t, after shrinking t so (K_a+K_R)t meets every threshold. Since lem-compcb-amplified-compression identifies the compressed unit at every level, there is a universal K_tar=K_u*(K_a+K_R) such that ||I_n tensor u_{S^{A_R}_{P^R}}-I_n tensor P^R||<=K_tar*t for every n>=1.
